infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Retrofit Field uses the camera to document jobsite work with time and location stamped photos.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Retrofit Field stamps each jobsite photo with the coordinates where it was taken, so the record proves where the work happened.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Retrofit Field can save stamped jobsite photos to your photo library.
